column1: # shards.tsv — the langspec corpus split into CI shards, one line per
# (shards_test.go) keeps it complete and disjoint; `make test-langspec
# SHARD=n` runs one shard and the ci.yml matrix runs them in parallel.
# Tests that share a memoised walk (gatherCensus: TestCompiledCoverage,
# two TestSpecProd*) stay together so the walk runs once. Balanced greedily
# on each test's wall clock with the parallel corpus walk on four idle
# cores, one test at a time (`go test ./langspec -v -parallel 1`,
# 2026-09-18: about 105 s per shard; a CI runner ran the eight-way split's
# shards in 95–165 s of test time, so nine is what the three-minute
# ceiling needs with the job's setup, not a preference). Rebalance when
# one shard drifts past the others by more than a minute.
